description: F2P/P2P classification of this task's graded observations. F2P fail on the delivered state and pass after the reference repair; P2P pass on both. Measured in the task image, not derived from names. tests/grade.py reads this file and runs exactly the observations it names.

groups.requirement: The token bucket's capacity is the quota's burst: 'n/unit burst b' admits b requests at once and RateLimitState.limit reports b.
A denied token-bucket request reports retry_after as the time until enough tokens for that request have refilled (not the time to refill the whole bucket).
With a timeout, Throttled waits and retries when timeout >= retry_after (equality included); the documented GCRA 2/s burst 2, timeout=0.5 example completes five requests at 0, 0, 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 s.
Hooks run in registration order around the rate-limit check: hooks=[A, B] gives A before, B before, rate_limit, B after, A after (sync and async).
MemoryStore is an LRU cache: reading a key marks it recently used, and exceeding MAX_SIZE evicts the least recently used key.
A fixed window admits exactly `limit` requests (cost units) per period; the request that reaches the limit is allowed and only exceeding it is denied (memory and Redis, sync and async).
The FastAPI integration keys the quota by method + route template + principal: different methods on one route have separate buckets.
RateLimitMiddleware adds the RateLimit-* headers to every response of a route whose rate-limit check passed, whatever the endpoint's status code (a 4xx or 5xx response still carries them).
quickstart/index.rst + README Quick Start: limit() deducts and returns RateLimitResult; the async API is the same under throttled.asyncio.
function-call.rst + README Function Call: default Throttled() (In-Memory, Token Bucket, 60 per minute); limit() never raises when limited; peek() reads without deducting.

decorator.rst: the decorator checks the limit before calling the function and raises LimitedError (message 'Rate limit exceeded: remaining=..., reset_after=..., retry_after=...'); cost comes from the Throttled instance; a decorator needs a key (DataError).
context-manager.rst: entering returns the RateLimitResult; exceeding the limit raises LimitedError and the block does not run (sync and async).

wait-retry.rst: with timeout, Throttled waits per retry_after and retries; timeout < retry_after returns the limited result immediately; the call-level timeout overrides the instance timeout; timeout must be positive or -1.
quota-configuration.rst: 'n/unit', 'n per unit', optional 'burst <b>'; the unit table's forms; burst defaults to n; invalid strings raise DataError.
Quota objects: per_sec/per_min/per_hour/per_day/per_week/per_duration; burst defaults to limit; Quota.rate.period / limit and burst fields (README data models).
specifying-algorithms.rst: `using` selects Fixed Window, Sliding Window, Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket or GCRA (RateLimiterType values); each limits as documented.

store-backends.rst In-Memory: Throttled uses a global MemoryStore by default (sync and async globals are independent); Throttled instances sharing one MemoryStore and quota limit the same key together; MemoryStore get/set/hset/hgetall/exists/ttl and expiry.
store-backends.rst Redis: RedisStore backs every algorithm (sync and async) with the same results as the in-memory store.

store-configuration.rst / store-backends.rst: RedisStore server URL schemes (redis://, redis+sentinel://, redis+cluster://) and the documented options REDIS_CLIENT_CLASS, SENTINEL_CLASS, REDIS_CLIENT_KWARGS, CONNECTION_POOL_KWARGS; the default server redis://localhost:6379/0; Sentinel port 26379 and service name mymaster by default; Cluster port 6379 by default.

hooks.rst: a hook wraps limit() and sees an immutable HookContext (key, cost, algorithm, store_type); hook types are validated (TypeError); a hook that raises is skipped, logged on 'throttled.hooks' / 'throttled.asyncio.hooks', and the request is counted once.

opentelemetry.rst: OTelHook records throttled.requests (Counter) and throttled.duration (Histogram, seconds) with attributes key, algorithm, store_type and result ('allowed' / 'denied'); sync and async.
fastapi.rst Basic Usage / Response Headers: allowed responses carry RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset; quota exhaustion is HTTP 429 with body {'detail': 'Rate limit exceeded'}.

fastapi.rst Constraints: async routes only and a Request parameter (TypeError); Limiter needs a quota; key_func may be async; without RateLimitMiddleware 429s still work but allowed responses have no headers; reversing the decorators disables limiting; root_path is part of the key; a per-route key_func overrides the Limiter's.

index/installation/README: sync and async packages expose the documented names; every exception inherits from BaseThrottledError; DataError for invalid parameters; RateLimitResult/RateLimitState fields.
